text: The historical wizard test replaces polling with notification, attribute and mutation helpers, while retaining state-based waits for notification disappearance and account readiness. The setup path registers its notification and protocol-selection waits before discovery. Review accepts the cleanup but only hopes it helps; Bugzilla later records seven macOS failures. The fixed tree has removed this old account-creation test, so these calls are historical evidence rather than a current API recipe. The Gecko helper signature and replacement coverage remain source-ingestion gaps.
title: Account wizard wait modernization remained an attempted intermittent fix
